nodes.label: Captain Lysandra Ironveil
nodes.description: In this recap, Lysandra repeatedly took command in the fight against the sewer monsters and other threats. She recharged her Commanding Shout, ordered allies to focus their attacks, removed a charm from Caelynn, and later recognized the party had the advantage and pushed for a final assault. The party then continued with post-battle coordination, including an attempted communications link with Grobnok that would be handled later.

beats.title: Opening pressure at the wall and first spell exchanges
beats.summary: The battle opens with hybrid monsters pressing toward the wall while the party trades spell and weapon attacks. Ogonob is hit in the darkness, Karsemine scorches the tripod monster, Ephanna and Bonogo are forced toward the meatwings, and Ogonob uses Misty Step to close on the tripod.

beats.title: Ranged counterfire and the meatwing compulsion spreads
beats.summary: Bonogo, Thrin, and Baergrom answer with shots at the hybrid creature, while the sewer monsters keep advancing. One tripod hits Ogonob, the sleeping tripod remains under Stafl’s spell, and the meatwings move toward the wall and begin charming multiple allies, drawing attacks onto Ephanna and Caelynn.

beats.title: Support magic and command abilities turn the tide
beats.summary: Stafl boosts Ephanna and disrupts the golem, Lysandra issues commands, and allies capitalize with weapon attacks. Karsemine, Bonogo, Baergrom, and Caelynn land heavy damage on meatwings and the tripod, including a removed charm and a boosted Magic Missile volley.

beats.title: Front line breaks the first major threats at the wall
beats.summary: A hybrid creature reaches the wall and begins damaging it, but Karsemine burns down the tripod, Ephanna and Ogonob damage the golem and meatwings, and Bonogo and Thrin help collapse the golem after knocking it prone. The battlefield shifts as the golem falls apart and the enemy line weakens.

beats.title: Sewer monsters breach the wall but are contained
beats.summary: One giant sewer monster climbs onto the wall into the middle of the party, while the other attacks through magical darkness and leaves a sticky gel behind. Baergrom uses mobility and protection maneuvers, then directs Bonogo, who kills the sewer monster attacking Ogonob with a dagger throw.
